newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bond issues hot, Sprint Spectrum up.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bond issues hot, Sprint Spectrum up.

text.p: New issues were the main focus of the U.S. corporate bond market on Thursday, as corporations issued more than $2 billion in new debt, traders said.

While the secondary market was slow, junk bonds of Sprint Spectrum L.P rose roughly two percent in heavy trading on rumors that Sprint Inc may increase its stake in the personal communications services provider, they noted.

Among new issues, Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc sold $1.2 billion in bonds with maturities ranging from seven to 100 years. Late on Thursday, AK Steel Holding Corp priced a whopping $550 million of new junk bonds.
